summary: Retested the public Expo web preview on a 375x667 viewport and reran the core FastAPI regression suite. Role selection, survivor status/message flow, settings controls, role switching, volunteer task navigation, and ACCEPT TASK were exercised successfully; backend tests passed 3/3 and live PATCH persistence returned Accepted.
action_items: Keep the public backend URL exported when invoking regression tests; the existing test module skips when EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is absent from the shell environment.
Consider removing fallback localhost MongoDB/DB_NAME defaults in backend/server.py to enforce the deployment environment contract.
Review Expo log WASM diagnostics on future SDK/build changes even though the current web bundle loaded and UI flow completed.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend server.py still supplies localhost defaults for MONGO_URL and DB_NAME, contrary to the fail-fast environment-variable contract, although the configured service is currently healthy.
Frontend api.ts prioritizes expoConfig.extra.backendUrl before EXPO_BACKEND_URL; verify this extra key cannot point at an unintended endpoint in production.
The browser test's error-selector evaluation had a quoting syntax error after all app assertions completed; this was a test-script issue, not an observed app failure.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of exercised assertions; no app failures observed

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ records through the existing regression POST tests and updated one seeded task assignment to TEST_mobile via PATCH; no cleanup endpoint exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL used. Browser local storage was cleared before role-picker testing. Expo loaded without a red screen; prior SQLite WASM log diagnostics remain worth monitoring. No authentication required.
rca_of_issue: Iteration 1 defects were not reproduced: offline web fallback is bundled well enough for the tested web flow, ACCEPT TASK now invokes PATCH /api/tasks/{task_id} and updates the task card, and requested testIDs are present. Initial pytest skip was caused by the shell not exporting the frontend .env variable; rerunning with EXPO_BACKEND_URL mapped to EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL passed all tests.
